tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po bse khrab pa'i thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga rdzogs ldan sprin gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swasti siddhaṃ bha wa tu// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug 'khor lo yis// snang srid dbang bsgyur khrag 'thung rgyal po dang*// gnyis su min pa'i drin can 'khor lo'i mgon// spyi gtsug rgyan du bsrel la phyag 'tshal bgyi// ye shes mig dkyus srid zhi'i mthar spros pa'i// lha srung gnyen po'i bka' sdod pho nya che// dregs pa'i rgyal po bse yi go khrab can// thugs dam bskang tshul 'dri la gnang ba stsol// 'jig rten gnas kyang gnas skabs rkyen sel zhing*// bzhed don la gor sgrub la dgos pa nyid// lus 'tsho'i zas kyis mchog la mi sman mod// sgrub pa'i dal rten gnas phyir dgos min nam// de la 'di'i bskang ba'i rim pa la 'jug pas sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang brgyan par yi dam dang chos skyong spyi'i sku rten dang khyad par 'di'i sku rten bcas yod na bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu'i khar yi dam chos skyong spyi'i gtor ma dang*/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi 'bul gtor bskang gtor dpal gtor zur gsum smug rtsis byugs pa mar gyi rtse rgyan ci mdzes su byas par mtheb skyu dang shas brgyan pa/ 'bul gtor dang yul gyi gzhi bdag gi gtor ma dang bcas pa/ de'i mthar zhi drag phyi nang gi mchod pa spyan gzigs gang 'byor rnams bsham/ sgrub pa po grogs dang bcas pa'i gdan bshams pa'i mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu/ rnga dung rkang gling rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar bya'o// gnyis pa la bdag mdun gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang dang yo byad byin rlabs kye rdo rje ltar byas nas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor kye rdo rje dang gshin rje gshed dmar la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i bsgom bzlas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/

gtor ma thams cad nang mchod chu chang gis bran la/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas 'thor zhing las sngags kyis bsang sbyang ba nas brtsams te/ ha hoḥhrīḥzhes lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ kye rdo rje sogs yi dam dang*/ chos skyong gur mgon zhal bzhi las mgon rnams bskyed cing gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ der dmag zor sogs chos skyong gzhan la gtor ma bsngo dgos na'ang 'bul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi gong der/ 'di'i gtor ma 'bru gsum dang ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyis slar yang byin brlabs dran par byas nas/ chos skyong ba 'di nyid kyi sku rten bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar padma'i gdan gyi steng du sprul pa'i rgyal po bse khrab pa sogs kyis bskyed nas/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan drangs nas dam tshig par bstim/ dam bzhag gtor ma 'bul ba sogs dkyus ltar bya'o// de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bcas phul nas/ yi dam dang chos skyong rnams kyi sngags kyi bzlas pa ci nus byas/ mchod bstod bshags bzlas bcas bya'o// bskang ba gur mgon gyi bskang ba gang rung dang 'brel na de dag sngon du btang nas 'di la 'jug go /bskang ba dngos la/ bskang rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i khrag zhag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling gi rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rang rang gi ming yig dang por thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rta kham pa rlung gi shugs can/ g.yag rgod kham nag bdud lug nag po/

bse'i ra skyes dmar po/ stag gzig mchong ba/ khyi dmar rngam pa/ 'phar spyang 'dur ba/ khra glag 'ug pa srin bya la sogs pa gdug pa'i bya rigs mang po lding zhing 'khor ba/ phyi nang gi dam rdzas mchod gtor go mtshon spyan gzigs kyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba dus 'khor ba ji srid bar du rgyun mi chad par sprul pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes shing mthu stobs phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya a warta ya hoḥ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la se gol gtogs/ oṃ dharma pā la ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul/ de nas rnga brdung zhing gyer bsgom sbrags par 'di skad gyer ro// hūm̐ don dam spros bral ngang du srid dang zhi// dman mchog dbye ba med kyang kun rdzob tu// 'jig rten mthu chen dregs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gzugs// sprul pa'i rgyal chen bse khrab can grags pa// sprul pa yang sprul 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas// bstan pa bsrung dang dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phyir// sna tshogs mchog pa'i mgron du gnyer byed na// thogs med 'dir byon rten la brtan par bzhugs// dran pa tsam gyis phrin las kun sgrub pa'i// rgyal po chen po dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas ni// me rlung rab tu 'khrugs par khrag zhag gi /rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi lag pa 'bum gdengs pas// zhing chen brdal ba'i sa gzhi bteg pa'i gzhir// btsan mkhar padma rā ga'i rtsig logs la// mchang gi mda' yab rkang rus pu shu brtsegs// byi ru'i ru bzhi bse yi sgo glegs can// keng rus bla khab phyur bur phub pa'i rtser// zhing gi rgyal mtshan citta'i tog ring btsugs// thod tshal me long ro skra'i rnga yab dang*// glo snying rgyu mar bstar ba'i 'phyang 'phrul can// 'jigs rung drag po'i gzhal med khang chen 'di// sprul pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul// snying brtse byang chub sems ldan dpa' bo ches// mngon spyod rno mtshon phyung nas gdug pa can// skye med dbyings bsgral khrag zhag mchod yon dang*// dbang po lnga yi me tog ci yang bkra// sha chen tshil chen sreg zar gtul ba'i spos// nyin byed la 'khu rkang mar sgros me'i phreng*// gser zhun 'khyil 'dra mkhris pa'i dri chab sbreng*// sha rus ri bor brtsegs pa'i zhal zas dang*// thod rnga rkang gling 'jigs rung nga ro'i dbyangs// dmar chen gtor ma ri dang mnyam par brtsegs// dgra bo'i snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nyer spyod rnams// sprul pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul// lha mi'i yul gyi gzugs sdug sgra snyan dbyangs// dri zhim ro drug bza' ba reg 'jam gos// rgyal srid rin chen bdun dang nye ba bdun// sa le sbram dang dngul dkar yongs 'du'i shing*// 'dod 'jo'i ba mo gter gyi bum pa bzang*// lo legs dus su smin pa'i nas 'bras gro// 'dzam bu'i snye mas mtshon pa'i shing thog rigs// stong 'khun yul gyi e dhwa da ka'i phon// sna tshogs dar zab 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor tshogs// sprul pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul// tsi na'i 'phrul bzos btags pa'i dar gos kyi// phod ka 'thab ber gser gyi ri mos bkra// rno mtshon stong gis gcod 'bigs mi bzod pa'i// bse khrab bse rmog nyi 'od ltar 'tsher la// sna tshogs dar gyi ba dan ches g.yo zhing*// bya rgod sgro yi ldem 'phrus brgyan pa dang*// rdo rje'i phreng ba bsgrigs pa'i rked chings las// mda' gzhu ral gri'i dong bu g.yas g.yon dpyang*// sgro ldan mde'u rno sbyar nyag phran stong*// rgyud kyis nyer bdungs sra brtan rdo rje'i gzhu// dgra snying thogs med 'bigs pa'i mdung rnon la// dar dmar ba dan cod pan zar bu bskyod// gang bsam skad cig dral ba'i rno ngar gyi// so ldan 'od 'bar ral gri dgra st+wa dang*// gnam lcags thog gi shugs la co 'dri mkhan// me sgyogs 'brug brgya bzhad pa'i gad rgyang can// dpa' bo dgra phyogs chas pa'i go mtshon 'di// sprul pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul// mtshams sprin dum bu sa la rgyu 'dra yi// rta mchog spu sdug rnga rngog mdzes pa'i lus// rmig bzhi goms stabs rlung dang lhan cig rtse// stong gsum skad cig bgrod pa'i theg pa bzang*// rno ba'i rwa ldan sha rgyas dal gyis 'gro// kham nag spu zhol g.yag rgod ra skyes lug

/sha dang khrag gi dri bsnams phyogs kun du// nyul ba'i stag gzig 'phar spyang wa khyi dmar// mchu sder stobs kyis dregs pa ji snyed dang*// bya rgod hor pa khra dang 'byung po'i bya// 'phur rtsal glog 'gyu ston pa sna tshogs kyis// chos skyong rgyal po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// rgyal chen bse khrab ldan pa'i thugs dam bskang*// las mkhan shan pa dmar po'i thugs dam bskang*// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang nas bcol pa'i phrin las sgrubs// phrin las bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' thos thugs bskyed mod// bar skabs rgyud 'khrugs dkar min las la goms// smon lam tshul min gyis sprul srid pa'i lha// 'khrul snang sems can srog gi bdag por gyur// gang tshe rgyal ba gdung 'tshob rig pa 'dzin// 'byung po kun la phan par 'doms rnams kyis// bsgo ba'i 'phrin yig snying la bris don soms// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar gyis// ye shes rang snang lha dang bka' srung spyi// khyad par gnyen mgon dregs pa'i sde dpon che'i// bka' sdod ci bgyi'i pho nya nyid byos la// rnam 'dren bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrubs// brtse chen kun dga' snying po e waṃ pa// mkhas mchog zung gi lugs bzang bshad sgrub mkhan// mkhas tshul gsum gyi phrin las tshogs dang mnyam// phyogs dus kun khyab rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrubs// de la phrag dog dug chus cher myos pa'i// log sgrub bar chad dug rlangs 'thul byed pa'i// bstan dgra dam nyams gdug rtsub 'khyog 'gros mkhan// khyod stobs ral gris bcad gtubs brlag par gyis// bstan phan lhag bsam bdag cag dpon slob la// sdang sems bsam sbyor ngan shom byed pa'i dgra// lo zlar ma 'gyangs las ngan lus dang bcas// nyams 'dzad gtugs pa'i las de khyod la gtad// kho bo slob 'khor nad med ring 'tsho sogs// phun tshogs srid pa'i chu gter rab 'phel zhing*// sdig spong chos spyod rnam bcur spyod pa sogs// byang chub spyod mtsho 'phel ba'i grogs kyang mdzod// bhyoḥdal rten bde 'byor ngal gsor spyod pa la// gegs byed 'byung gdon 'khrugs pa'i nad dang gdon// lha mi'i cho 'phrul rmi ltas mtshan ngan rnams// da lta nyid du bzlog cing bsgyur mdzod cig

/mdor na dge legs phun sum tshogs dgu la// gzhar yang mdzol med legs par sbyor ba dang*// nyes phyogs kun las srung ba'i mel tshe yis// rtag par rnam par rgyal ba'i grogs mdzod cig /bstod cing bstab pa ni/ rab khros sku dmar byi ru'i lhun po la// bse yi khrab rmog mtshams sprin gos kyis 'khyud// dar zab phod ka'i rlung gi rgyal mtshan bcas// dran pas dgra snying 'dar byed dregs pa'i rje// 'khor gsum rked par bskor nas 'jigs rung gi /nga ros sdang dgra lo zlar 'gyang ngam zhes// rdo rje zhags pas yan lag dam bcings nas// btsan mdung dmar po snying gi dkyil du bsnun// lcags sgrog mtshan pa'i zhabs gnyis cang shes rta// kham rag rnga rngog zar bu g.yo mdzes la// rin chen sga srab spras pa bcibs nas ni// bka' yi bya rar rgyu ba las mkhan che// sprul pa'i rgyal chen bse khrab can la bstod// rgyal ba'i bka' thos padmā ka ra sogs// rig 'dzin rnams kyis bstan pa bstan 'dzin bcas// bsrung bar gnyer gtad rdzu 'phrul nus pa'i gter// rgyal chen sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyen po 'bul// da jus legs pa'i gsal 'debs rten du bstab// 'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen ngan bzlog pa dang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod byed mi mthun phyogs// zhi bas ma thul gdug pa can gyi rigs// drag po'i stobs kyis tshar gcod phrin las mdzod// ces dang gtor ma sgrub khang gi steng du btang ngo*// zhes sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po bse khrab pa'i thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga rdzogs ldan sprin gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gnas 'ji bla ma blo gros bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa'i lugs bzang gi rjes su slob 'dun ma bor tsam gyi bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/

rab byung 'dod pa'i sna tshogs zhes pa chu rta'i gnam lo'i gral tshes dge bar dpal lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa maṅga laṃ bi dza yantu// // ༄༅// rgyal chen bse khrab par gtor ma'i cho ga bka' sdod dregs pa dgyes pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// 'khor 'das dregs pa'i sde tshogs rnams// dbang sdud bran du bkol byed pa// bla ma lhag pa'i lhar btud de// bka' sdod dgyes pa'i cho ga 'dri// 'dir rgyal po chen po bse khrab par gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma bran pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ sku rten yod na bsang sbyangs/ mdun du padma'i gdan gyi steng du sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po bse khrab pa/ sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas mdung dmar ba dan dang bcas pa dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa la bsnun pa/ g.yon pas zhags pa nag po lcags kyi a long gis mtshan pas bstan dgra la 'debs shing yan lag thams cad dam du 'ching ba/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs nas gnod byed la sdang mig tu lta bas srog dbugs sdud pa/ dbu la bse rmog gsol ba la rgod kyi dang sgro dang dar tshon sna lngas brgyan pa/ sku la ber ljang dmar nyis brtsegs kyi steng du bse khrab nyi 'od ltar 'tsher ba la rgyan du mas brgyan pa mnabs pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis mdzes par byas pa/ rdo rje gshibs pa'i ska rags las chos 'khor rgya chen po skyong zhing bstan dgra dam nyams kyi snying la 'bigs pa'i thog mdas bkang ba'i dong pa dang*/ chu srin mgo bo'i mchog ma can gyi gzhu bdungs pa'i gzig shubs dang bcas pa g.yas g.yon du dpyangs shing*/ gdug pa can gyi snying rtsa gcod pa'i ral gri dang lhan cig btags pa/ rdzu 'phrul rlung gi shugs ldan stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i rta mchog rag pa la bcibs shing*/

mtshal rta rting dkar rol du khrid pa/ me rlung rab tu 'tshubs ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas dang*/ byang phyogs hor gyi pho brang*/ chos 'khor g.yag sde/ dpal gyi bsam yas/ dpal ldan gsang phu'i gnas mchog dam pa rnams nas sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po bse khrab pa 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ hūm̐ rgyal ba'i phrin las 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshul// ye shes srung ma'i bka' sdod mthu rtsal can// 'jigs rung sprul pa'i rgyal po bse khrab pa// ma thogs myur du bcol ba'i las la byon// bde legs dpal ster phrin las lha yi gnas// sum cu rtsa gsum lngas rtsen pho brang nas// sngags srung dregs pa'i sde dpon stobs po che// las bzhi sgrub mdzad spyan 'dren gnas 'dir byon// o rgyan hor yul bod kyi gtsug lag khang*// ma lus bsrung bar khas blang dam tshig can// mna' zan tshe srog phral ba'i las la brtson// bdud 'dul dpa' bo spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus nas// snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin cing*// rgyud sde'i snying po 'gro don gter du sbas// padma'i bka' sdong spyan 'dren gnas 'dir byon// oṃ ma hā rā dzā ya e hye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig par bstim/ ma hā rā dza sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po bse khrab pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rngog lo khu dbon gyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde tshugs/ khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang 'dod pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du grub pa'i phrin las dang*/

stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ mtshan sngags de nyid sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ rgyal ba'i phrin las 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshul// ye shes srung ma'i bka' sdod mthu rtsal can// 'jigs rung sprul pa'i rgyal po bse khrab pa// bstan dgra tshar gcod dam tshig can la bstod// ye shes rang snang lha dang bka' srung spyi// zhes sogs nas/ phyogs dus kun khyab rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrubs// ces bstod cing phrin las bcol lo// zhes sprul pa'i rgyal po bse khrab pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga bka' sdod dregs pa dgyes pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //'di na gzhan don sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i ched// lhag pa'i lha yi bsnyen sgrub la zhugs bdag /nam zhig dam bca' ma grol de srid du// bstan 'di las ni ldang bar mi byed pas// dge chos la sdang smon lam log pa'i las// bar chad nyer 'tshe brtsams pa'i bgegs rigs rnams// rdo rje'i srung 'khor 'da' bar 'jug ma byed// ye shes me lces bsregs par gdon mi za// gzhan la gnod byas le lan rang nyid la// mi bzad sdug bsngal 'byung ba rgyu 'bras gshis// de bas 'gro la phan pa'i sems bzung na// 'phral yun bde ba'i go 'phang thob 'gyur ro// sarba maṅga laṃ// zhes tho'am sgo 'gram lta bur 'dri bar 'os pa 'di'ang hor nyag brag dgon gyi bla ma byams pa'i ngor tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
